articles.title: Getting started with Radiora
articles.summary: Create your account, your clinic, and start your 30-day free trial.
body: To begin, click "Try free for 30 days" and follow the five steps: create your account, verify your email then your phone, fill in your clinic details, and start the trial. Provisioning is fully automatic — no manual intervention required.
Once signed in, the dashboard brings together your exams, reports and notifications. The first clinic admin can then invite the team from Settings → Users.
Your trial lasts 30 days. You'll receive reminders 14, 7 and 3 days before it expires, and on the day itself, to activate your subscription via Wave or Orange Money.

articles.title: Creating and structuring a report
articles.summary: Use structured templates and AI-assisted structuring.
body: From an exam, open the report editor. Choose a template matching the modality and body region: structured fields guide you toward a complete, consistent report.
AI-assisted structuring can turn free text into organized sections. The AI always proposes a suggestion — the radiologist validates it. No finalization is automatic.
Only radiologists can validate and sign a report. Secretaries never validate a diagnosis.

articles.title: Using voice dictation
articles.summary: Dictate your reports on desktop or mobile.
body: Voice dictation is available on desktop and mobile. Start recording from the report editor; the transcript appears in the active field and stays fully under your control.
You can review, correct and structure the text before validation. The transcript is never finalized without the radiologist's review.
On mobile, open the mobile dictation view to quickly record your notes and attach them to the relevant exam.

articles.title: Managing your subscription and payments
articles.summary: Plans, Wave and Orange Money payments, invoices and receipts.
body: Go to Settings → Billing to review your plan, invoices and receipts. You can pay an invoice or change plan directly from this page.
Payments are made via Wave or Orange Money, in FCFA. Once payment is confirmed, your subscription is activated automatically and a receipt is generated.
A receipt is issued for every successful payment — subscription, renewal or plan change — and remains available in your billing history.

articles.title: Managing your team and roles
articles.summary: Invite users and assign the right roles.
body: From Settings → Users, the clinic admin can invite radiologists, technicians, secretaries and other team members.
Each role has strict permissions. For example, only radiologists validate and sign reports, while secretaries handle reception and routing without ever validating a diagnosis.
Data isolation is guaranteed at the platform level: no organization can see another's data.
